outro_summary: Alfie tries to turn a twenty-percent partnership into a complete takeover. Tommy makes the cost of forcing that demand too high, covers the attempted escape and supplies evidence that his threat is credible. The final deal is thirty-five percent. Neither man earns trust; both discover the price of continuing the argument.
